newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Romanian Commerical Bank U.S. Euronotes.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Romanian Commerical Bank U.S. Euronotes.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday it assigned its BB minus rating to the $75 million unsecured Euronote issue by Romanian Commercial Bank S.A. (RCB)
The outlook was stable, S&P said in a news release.

"The rating is based on the strong implicit and explicit support for RCB from the Republic of Romania adn the bank's strong position in the Romanian banking system, in the particular the corporate sector," it said.
"Offsetting these positive factors, however, are the difficult economic environment and the bank's significant asset-quality problems," it said.
